column1: # Values published as examples or built into emulators: they match a key pattern, but they are
# public and give no access to anything. A match that holds one is not a key. One line each, tab
# separated: the key id (data/keys.tsv), a part of the value, at least 20 characters and never one
# its key pattern matches alone, and where the vendor publishes it. After editing, run: bash tools/gen.sh
